proof:
Source: step 7 of the supplied proof of the selected theorem. The backward difference quotient of F(r) = μ(B_r(x₁)) controls the measure of thin inner annuli. Simon Ch. 6, proof of 8.2, uses f′(r) for f(r) = M(T⌞B_r(ξ)) in the same way in displays (2)–(3) (chapter-06.txt lines 2338–2357).

Notation: B_r(x₁) = ball x₁ r is the open ball, |x − x₁| = dist x x₁, F(r) := (μ(B_r(x₁))).toReal for r ∈ ℝ, A_h := {x : ρ − h < |x − x₁| < ρ}, ofReal := ENNReal.ofReal. Only the values F(ρ) and F(ρ − h) with h > 0 are used. These are finite measures (step 3(b)), so the convention toReal ∞ = 0 never applies.

1. (Backward difference quotients converge to d.) Since F has derivative d at ρ, t⁻¹·(F(ρ + t) − F(ρ)) → d as t → 0 through negative values, i.e. along 𝓝[<] 0 (Mathlib HasDerivAt.tendsto_slope_zero_left; on ℝ the scalar action • is multiplication). The map h ↦ −h tends from 𝓝[>] 0 to 𝓝[<] 0: it is continuous with −0 = 0, and −h < 0 whenever h > 0 (tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff). Compose the two limits and use the identity (−h)⁻¹·(F(ρ + (−h)) − F(ρ)) = h⁻¹·(F(ρ) − F(ρ − h)), valid for every real h. This gives q(h) := h⁻¹·(F(ρ) − F(ρ − h)) → d as h → 0 along 𝓝[>] 0 (Filter.Tendsto.congr').

2. (The limit in [0, ∞].) ofReal : ℝ → [0, ∞] is continuous (ENNReal.continuous_ofReal), so ofReal(q(h)) → ofReal(d) along 𝓝[>] 0. The filter 𝓝[>] 0 on ℝ is nontrivial, hence liminf_{𝓝[>] 0} ofReal(q(h)) = ofReal(d) (Filter.Tendsto.liminf_eq).

3. (Pointwise comparison.) Fix h > 0.
 (a) A_h ⊆ B_ρ(x₁) ∖ B_{ρ−h}(x₁): if x ∈ A_h then |x − x₁| < ρ, so x ∈ B_ρ(x₁); and x ∉ B_{ρ−h}(x₁), since otherwise |x − x₁| < ρ − h < |x − x₁|.
 (b) B_{ρ−h}(x₁) ⊆ B_ρ(x₁) because ρ − h ≤ ρ (ball_subset_ball); hence μ(B_{ρ−h}(x₁)) ≤ μ(B_ρ(x₁)) < ∞.
 (c) B_{ρ−h}(x₁) is open, hence measurable (measurableSet_ball), and has finite measure by (b). Therefore μ(B_ρ(x₁) ∖ B_{ρ−h}(x₁)) = μ(B_ρ(x₁)) − μ(B_{ρ−h}(x₁)) (measure_sdiff, the current name of the deprecated measure_diff). Both measures are finite, so μ(B_ρ(x₁)) = ofReal(F(ρ)) and μ(B_{ρ−h}(x₁)) = ofReal(F(ρ − h)) (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal). Since F(ρ − h) ≥ 0, ofReal(F(ρ)) − ofReal(F(ρ − h)) = ofReal(F(ρ) − F(ρ − h)) (ENNReal.ofReal_sub).
 (d) By (a) and monotonicity of μ, then (c), then ENNReal.ofReal_mul (using h⁻¹ ≥ 0): ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ(A_h) ≤ ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ(B_ρ(x₁) ∖ B_{ρ−h}(x₁)) = ofReal(h⁻¹)·ofReal(F(ρ) − F(ρ − h)) = ofReal(h⁻¹·(F(ρ) − F(ρ − h))) = ofReal(q(h)).

4. (Conclusion.) The inequality of 3(d) holds for every h ∈ (0, ∞), and (0, ∞) ∈ 𝓝[>] 0 (self_mem_nhdsWithin). By monotonicity of liminf under an eventual inequality (Filter.liminf_le_liminf) together with step 2, liminf_{h→0⁺} ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ(A_h) ≤ liminf_{h→0⁺} ofReal(q(h)) = ofReal(d). The boundedness side conditions of Filter.liminf_le_liminf are discharged automatically in the complete lattice [0, ∞], e.g. via `refine liminf_le_liminf ?_`. ∎
